title: Code Chronicle
description: Match locks and keys by checking pin height compatibility.
writeup:
## Approach

Parse lock and key schematics into column heights. Locks have '#' on the top row, keys have '#' on the bottom row.

## Part 1

For each lock/key pair, check if the sum of heights in every column doesn't exceed the schematic height (7 rows). Count all fitting pairs.

## Part 2

Christmas day — no part 2 puzzle. Merry Christmas!
